entries.subject: Owned-environment Windows x86_64 libmpv source-captured build
evidence: failed step: Build the Clang toolchain and package Windows libmpv
ld.lld: error: Not an int attribute (Producer: 'LLVM23.1.0-rust-1.100.0-nightly' Reader: 'LLVM 22.1.8')
entries.summary: The pinned recipe completed the toolchain and dependency builds, then failed while linking mpv.exe and libmpv-2.dll because Rust ThinLTO bitcode from LLVM 23 was read by LLVM 22.1.8.
limitations: No Windows binary artifact was produced.
No corresponding-source artifact was produced.
Only the build-log artifact was uploaded; this is not a DLL or product acceptance result.
entries.next_action: Disable package ThinLTO, enforce the cached setting before source download, run the narrow workflow and continuity tests, then request separate commit approval.

entries.subject: Early Rust and LLVM ThinLTO mismatch prevention contract
entries.summary: The workflow explicitly disables package ThinLTO and verifies the cached CMake value before source download, preventing the observed Rust LLVM 23 bitcode from reaching the LLVM 22.1.8 linker.
limitations: This is an uncommitted workflow and documentation contract on top of the recorded base commit.
No new source build, DLL, native smoke, or installed-artifact test ran.
entries.next_action: Request separate commit approval; after commit and push approvals, request separate approval before one new source-captured build.

entries.subject: Owned-environment Windows x86_64 libmpv source build and independent artifact verification
evidence: independent source archive listing: 98736 entries; 113 source directories; 89491 source-file checksum lines
entries.summary: The pinned owned environment built mpv and libmpv successfully. Independent download verified all published artifact digests, every embedded checksum, full binary extraction, the required corresponding-source metadata and source tree, and a clean 302/302 mpv link with an empty mpv error log.
limitations: This proves the source build and its captured artifacts only.
The new DLL has not replaced the repository or installed DLL and has not run a native smoke test.
Non-libmpv corresponding-source, installed notice, and Qt relinking blockers remain open.
entries.next_action: Prepare a bounded DLL replacement and native-smoke plan; changing the repository DLL, building the product, installing, tagging, or releasing still requires separate approval.
